provenance: Issue #27 M3 grammar-boundary corpus; frozen against the named Legend grammar endpoint. Breadth and labeling corrections from issue #315's live re-verification against this same pinned build.
update_policy: Existing version directories are immutable against engine drift: a Legend version change creates a new legend-<version> directory, reviewed against its oracle differences, rather than silently rewriting a frozen label. A demonstrated labeling mistake in an existing directory — verified live against this exact same pinned engine build, and disclosed with that evidence in the correcting PR — may still be fixed in place through normal review; only `--refresh` is blocked from ever rewriting a label unattended.
